tests.name: fixture gateway serves the G1 HTTP contract and binds loopback-only
tests.reason: This lane is a local, loopback-only tools fixture (apps/mobile/tools/fixture-gateway) with no deployed surface, so there is nothing on staging to probe. The fixture suite is read-only by construction: it starts the server on 127.0.0.1, asserts each route's shape (app-config passing the real parseAppConfigResponse, the auth/me 401 toggle, notifications/token, AASA/assetlinks) and that it refuses to bind to any non-loopback/non-private address. It opens no outbound connection and can never reach staging or production.
